protocol: CAL fits temperatures; VAL selects; TEST is generated only by `final`
rule: feasible = worst per-class confident-wrong <= 2 % pooled AND <= 5 % in every VALIDATION regime AND decision-worse-than-prior <= 5 %; best = feasible candidate with the highest useful rate (correct and not inconclusive), ties -> simpler name; ADOPTED only if it beats the Phase 10 guarded model on VALIDATION (worst-regime confident-wrong lower by >= 2 points, or not higher with >= 3 points more useful decisions); otherwise nothing is adopted and the shipped model stays the default
